metadata.name: GetMerchantStatement
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is Used to get the details of the Merchant Statement.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

children.name: MerchantStatementAdjustmentList
children.description: Header of Merchant Statement Adjustment Group Which will contain all details Adjustements as a

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Merchant Name which is assigned to a Merchant Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXXXXX Example: ABCD LLC Allowable Values: 9

children.name: MerchantNumber
children.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant, Mandatory If Merchant Number not Inputted in API Request Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: MerchantStatementDate
children.description: Date for which Merchant statement is  generated Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 05/01/2020

children.name: MerchantStatementFromDate
children.description: From Date of the Merchant statement Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 05/01/2020

children.name: MerchantStatementToDate
children.description: To Date of the Merchant statement Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 05/01/2020

children.name: ProductName
children.description: The tag reflects the product name Valid  Values: a-z Format: xxxxxx Example: abcsolutionsrevolving Allowable Values: 50

children.name: GrossSalesCount
children.description: Count of Gross Sales Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 5

children.name: ReturnReversalsCount
children.description: Count of Sales Returns and Reversals Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 5

children.name: GrossSalesAmount
children.description: Total Gross Sales amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: ReturnReversalsAmount
children.description: Total Returns and Reversals amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: MerchantFee
children.description: Merchant Fee amount Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: MerchantFeeReversal
children.description: Total Merchant Fee Reversal Amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: NetAmountDue
children.description: Total Net amount due as on statement date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: TotalAmountDue
children.description: Total amount due as on statement date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: TotalAmountDueCount
children.description: Count of Total Amount Due Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 5

children.name: MerchantFeeBreakdownList
children.description: Header of Merchant Fee Breakdown Details

children.name: CreditPlanMaster
children.description: Plan Name associated with the card account. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Format: XXXXX Example: 6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TransactionCounts
children.description: Count of Transactions * for the Credit Plan Master as on statement date Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 5

children.name: MerchantRate
children.description: Merchant Discount Rate applicable for the Merchant *Merchant Rate set for  the Credit Plan Master Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX % Example: 5.00%

children.name: TransactionsVolume
children.description: Transactions Volume amount * for the Credit Plan Master as on statement date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: MerchantFee
children.description: Merchant Fee amount *Merchant Fee Amount set for  the Credit Plan Master Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: GrandTotalList
children.description: Header of Grand Total List, contains the Grand Totals for Transaction Volume, Transaction Counts and Merchant Fee

children.name: GrandTotalTransactionsVolume
children.description: Grand Total Transactions Volume amount Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: GrandTotalTransactionCounts
children.description: Grand Total Count of Transactions Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 5

children.name: GrandTotalMerchantFee
children.description: Grand Total Amount of Merchant Fee Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: MerchantStatementHistoryList
children.description: Header of Merchant Statement History array Which will contain all details for Each Transaction occured for the Merchant in an array.

children.name: PurchaseTranID
children.description: Transaction ID generated for The Purchase Transaction For Return Transaction also the Transaction ID will be returned in this tag and User must check the Transaction Description Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 122390308

children.name: ReversalTranID
children.description: Transaction ID generated for The Reversal Transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 122390308

children.name: Transactiontime
children.description: Time stamp when Transaction occured Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MMDDYYYYHHMMSS Example: 01012020110505

children.name: TransactionPostTime
children.description: Actual datetime timestamp when transaction was posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MMDDYYYYHHMMSS Example: 01012020110505

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Time stamp when Transaction occured Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MMDDYYYYHHMMSS Example: 01012020110505

children.name: MerchantFee
children.description: Merchant Fee amount Valid  Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: CreditPlanMaster
children.description: Plan name associated with the card account. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CPMID
children.description: Identifier to get Credit Plan Master applicable on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 251215

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid  Values:A-Z Format: Example: Purchase/Payment Allowable Values: 80

children.name: MerchantRate
children.description: Merchant Discount Rate applicable for the Merchant *Merchant Rate set for  the Credit Plan Master Valid  Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX % Example: 5.00%

children.name: NetSettlementAmount
children.description: Amount Calculated after Deductions if Any from the Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XXX.XX Example: 200.00
